import { describe, it, expect, beforeEach } from "vitest";
import { Decimal } from "@prisma/client";
import { OperationsService } from "../src/operations/operations.service";
import type {
  OperationRow,
  DashboardQuery,
  DashboardResult,
  CompanyTotals,
  SimulateWriteInput,
  OrderStatus,
} from "../src/operations/operations.types";
import {
  ResourceNotFoundError,
  InvalidDateRangeError,
  ValidationError,
} from "../src/operations/operations.types";

// ─── In-memory state ───

interface PaymentOrderRow {
  id: string;
  companyId: string;
  workerId: string;
  status: string;
  amount: Decimal;
  currency: string;
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
}

interface OperationProjectionRow {
  orderId: string;
  companyId: string;
  status: string;
  amount: Decimal;
  currency: string;
  workerName: string;
  workerRole: string;
  lastEventType: string | null;
  createdAt: Date;
}

interface CompanyTotalRow {
  companyId: string;
  totalAmount: Decimal;
  orderCount: number;
}

interface WorkerRow {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  role: string;
}

// ─── Test context: in-memory DB + mocks ───

class TestContext {
  paymentOrders = new Map<string, PaymentOrderRow>();
  operations = new Map<string, OperationProjectionRow>();
  companyTotals = new Map<string, CompanyTotalRow>();
  workers = new Map<string, WorkerRow>();

  repo: any;
  prisma: any;

  constructor() {
    this.repo = this.buildRepoMock();
    this.prisma = this.buildPrismaMock();
  }

  private buildRepoMock() {
    const self = this;
    return {
      findWorkerById: async (id: string): Promise<WorkerRow | null> => {
        return self.workers.get(id) ?? null;
      },

      findLastEventForOrder: async (_orderId: string): Promise<string | null> => {
        // No events in these tests
        return null;
      },

      upsertOperation: async (
        _tx: unknown,
        input: SimulateWriteInput,
        worker: WorkerRow,
        lastEventType: string | null,
      ): Promise<void> => {
        const source = self.paymentOrders.get(input.order_id);
        self.operations.set(input.order_id, {
          orderId: input.order_id,
          companyId: input.company_id,
          status: input.status,
          amount: new Decimal(input.amount),
          currency: input.currency,
          workerName: worker.name,
          workerRole: worker.role,
          lastEventType,
          createdAt: source ? source.createdAt : new Date(),
        });
      },

      upsertCompanyTotal: async (
        _tx: unknown,
        companyId: string,
        deltaAmount: string,
        deltaCount: number,
      ): Promise<void> => {
        const existing = self.companyTotals.get(companyId);
        if (!existing) {
          self.companyTotals.set(companyId, {
            companyId,
            totalAmount: new Decimal(deltaAmount),
            orderCount: deltaCount,
          });
        } else {
          existing.totalAmount = existing.totalAmount.plus(new Decimal(deltaAmount));
          existing.orderCount += deltaCount;
        }
      },

      getCompanyTotal: async (companyId: string): Promise<CompanyTotals | null> => {
        const t = self.companyTotals.get(companyId);
        if (!t) return null;
        return {
          company_id: companyId,
          total_amount: t.totalAmount.toString(),
          order_count: t.orderCount,
        };
      },

      queryDashboard: async (query: DashboardQuery): Promise<DashboardResult> => {
        let rows = Array.from(self.operations.values()).filter(
          (op) => op.companyId === query.company_id,
        );

        if (query.status !== undefined) {
          rows = rows.filter((op) => op.status === query.status);
        }
        if (query.date_from !== undefined) {
          rows = rows.filter((op) => op.createdAt >= query.date_from!);
        }
        if (query.date_to !== undefined) {
          rows = rows.filter((op) => op.createdAt <= query.date_to!);
        }

        // Sort: created_at DESC, order_id DESC
        rows.sort((a, b) => {
          const timeDiff = b.createdAt.getTime() - a.createdAt.getTime();
          if (timeDiff !== 0) return timeDiff;
          return b.orderId > a.orderId ? 1 : -1;
        });

        const total_count = rows.length;
        const offset = (query.page - 1) * query.page_size;
        const pageRows = rows.slice(offset, offset + query.page_size);

        return {
          data: pageRows.map((op) => ({
            order_id: op.orderId,
            company_id: op.companyId,
            status: op.status as OrderStatus,
            amount: op.amount.toString(),
            currency: op.currency,
            worker_name: op.workerName,
            worker_role: op.workerRole,
            last_event_type: op.lastEventType,
            created_at: op.createdAt,
          })),
          total_count,
          page: query.page,
          page_size: query.page_size,
        };
      },
    };
  }

  private buildPrismaMock() {
    const self = this;
    return {
      $transaction: async (callback: (tx: any) => Promise<unknown>) => {
        const tx = {
          paymentOrder: {
            findUnique: async ({ where }: { where: { id: string } }) => {
              const order = self.paymentOrders.get(where.id);
              return order ? { ...order } : null;
            },
            create: async ({ data }: { data: Partial<PaymentOrderRow> }) => {
              const order: PaymentOrderRow = {
                id: data.id!,
                companyId: data.companyId!,
                workerId: data.workerId!,
                status: data.status!,
                amount: data.amount as Decimal,
                currency: data.currency!,
                createdAt: (data.createdAt as Date) ?? new Date(),
                updatedAt: (data.updatedAt as Date) ?? new Date(),
              };
              self.paymentOrders.set(order.id, order);
              return { ...order };
            },
            update: async ({
              where,
              data,
            }: {
              where: { id: string };
              data: Partial<PaymentOrderRow>;
            }) => {
              const existing = self.paymentOrders.get(where.id);
              if (!existing) throw new Error("PaymentOrder not found");
              const updated: PaymentOrderRow = { ...existing, ...data };
              self.paymentOrders.set(where.id, updated);
              return { ...updated };
            },
          },
          operation: {
            findUnique: async ({ where }: { where: { orderId: string } }) => {
              const op = self.operations.get(where.orderId);
              return op ? { ...op } : null;
            },
          },
        };
        return callback(tx);
      },
    };
  }

  // Helper to seed the projection and totals directly (bypassing simulateWrite)
  seedOperation(opts: {
    orderId: string;
    companyId: string;
    status: OrderStatus;
    amount: string;
    currency?: string;
    workerName?: string;
    workerRole?: string;
    createdAt: Date;
  }): void {
    this.operations.set(opts.orderId, {
      orderId: opts.orderId,
      companyId: opts.companyId,
      status: opts.status,
      amount: new Decimal(opts.amount),
      currency: opts.currency ?? "USD",
      workerName: opts.workerName ?? "Test Worker",
      workerRole: opts.workerRole ?? "driver",
      lastEventType: null,
      createdAt: opts.createdAt,
    });

    // Ensure a totals row exists for the company
    if (!this.companyTotals.has(opts.companyId)) {
      this.companyTotals.set(opts.companyId, {
        companyId: opts.companyId,
        totalAmount: new Decimal(0),
        orderCount: 0,
      });
    }
    const total = this.companyTotals.get(opts.companyId)!;
    total.totalAmount = total.totalAmount.plus(new Decimal(opts.amount));
    total.orderCount += 1;
  }
}

```

   - Looks up last event (may be null)
   - Builds simulateInput from the order
4. If batchEntries is empty (all workers missing), skips the transaction
5. Within a transaction:
   - Upserts operation rows
   - Collects affected companies
   - Recomputes company totals (absolute SUM/COUNT, not delta)

Key branches that could be wrong independently:
- Invalid date range (date_from >= date_to) → error
- Valid date range with no orders → returns 0 rows_rewritten
- Worker not found for an order → skipped, not counted in rows_rewritten
- Last event is null → projection row has last_event_type = null
- Multiple orders for same company in one batch → totals recomputed once per company (not per order)
- Batch boundary: exactly 500 orders vs 501 orders (two batches)
- Idempotency: running twice produces same result
- Repair: corrupt a projection row, re-derive restores it
- Company totals are recomputed as absolute values (not delta) — concurrent writes during re-derivation
- The re-derivation does NOT delete rows outside its window
- Empty batch (all workers missing) skips the transaction entirely

- date_from > date_to (should reject)
- Exactly 500 orders (one batch) vs 501 (two batches)

- Concurrent write during re-derivation: a new order is inserted for a company mid-batch; the totals recompute at end of batch should include it (absolute SUM/COUNT)

- Re-derivation of a window where the source order's amount changed → projection is updated to new amount

Let me structure the list:

1. Invalid date range (date_from === date_to) throws InvalidDateRangeError
2. Invalid date range (date_from > date_to) throws InvalidDateRangeError
3. Window with no matching orders returns rows_rewritten = 0
4. Corrupted projection row is restored after re-derive of the containing window
5. Re-derivation is idempotent: running the same window twice yields identical projection rows and totals
6. Re-derivation updates a projection row when the source amount/status changed
7. Worker not found for an order: that order is skipped, not counted in rows_rewritten, and its projection row (if any) is left untouched
8. Last event is null: projection row's last_event_type is null
9. Company totals are recomputed as absolute SUM/COUNT from source (not delta) — a concurrent insert during the batch is reflected in the post-batch total
10. Batch boundary: exactly BATCH_SIZE orders produce one transaction; BATCH_SIZE+1 produce two transactions (verify via row count and no cross-contamination)
11. Re-derivation does not delete or modify projection rows outside the requested window
12. All orders in a batch have missing workers: no transaction is opened (no totals recompute side-effect)

## reply

- **re-derive rejects a window where date_from equals date_to** — proves the guard uses `>=` (not `>`); would fail if the comparison is strictly greater-than or missing, letting a zero-width window through to an empty SELECT that returns 0 rows instead of raising `InvalidDateRangeError`.

- **re-derive rejects a window where date_from is after date_to** — proves the guard catches an inverted range; would fail if the comparison logic is reversed or only checks equality.

- **re-derive on a window with no matching orders returns `{ rows_rewritten: 0 }` without side-effects** — proves the empty-result path is handled; would fail if the code throws on an empty array, or if it still opens a transaction and "recomputes" totals for companies that have no orders in the window (a no-op if absolute, but a mutation if delta-based).

- **re-derive restores a projection row whose status, amount, and last_event_type were manually corrupted to wrong values** — proves the upsert actually overwrites an existing row (not insert-only) and maps every denormalised field from source; would fail if the upsert is keyed wrong, a field is omitted from the update set, or the code reads from the projection instead of source.

- **re-derive is idempotent: running the same window a second time yields byte-identical projection rows and unchanged company totals** — proves totals are computed as absolute SUM/COUNT from source, not as a delta added on top; would fail if the totals step adds the window's amounts again (double-counting) or if the upsert creates a duplicate row.

- **re-derive reflects a concurrent source update: an order's amount is changed in `payment_orders` after the window fetch but before the batch commits, and the projection and totals reflect the new amount** — proves the absolute SUM/COUNT reads source at commit time; would fail if the code snapshots the amount during the fetch loop and writes that stale value, or if totals are delta-based (the write path already applied the delta, so an absolute recompute is the only correct reconciliation).

- **re-derive skips an order whose worker_id does not resolve to a row in `workers`, excludes it from `rows_rewritten`, and leaves any pre-existing projection row for that order untouched** — proves the missing-worker branch is a `continue`, not a throw or a zero-fill; would fail if the code throws `ResourceNotFoundError` (aborting the whole window), counts the skipped row in `rows_rewritten`, or writes a projection row with empty worker fields.

- **re-derive sets `last_event_type` to null on the projection row when the order has no events** — proves the nullable path is handled; would fail if the code substitutes an empty string, a default sentinel, or throws on the null from `findLastEventForOrder`.

- **re-derive with exactly BATCH_SIZE (500) orders completes in a single batch, and with BATCH_SIZE + 1 (501) orders both rows are written and totals for all affected companies are correct** — proves the slice arithmetic at the boundary is `i < orders.length` with step 500 (not off-by-one); would fail if the loop condition is `<=` (skipping the last row) or if the second batch's per-company set is contaminated by the first batch's companies.

- **re-derive does not modify or delete projection rows whose `created_at` falls outside the requested window** — proves the operation is scoped to the window; would fail if the code groups by `company_id` and rewrites all rows for that company regardless of date, or issues a DELETE to "clean up" before upserting.

- **re-derive correctly attributes totals to distinct companies: a window containing orders from company A and company B produces independent, correct totals for each** — proves the `affectedCompanies` set is keyed per company and the recompute is per-company, not a global aggregate; would fail if the code sums across companies or shares a single accumulator.

- **re-derive returns a `rows_rewritten` count that excludes orders skipped due to missing workers** — proves the counter increments only after the worker check passes; would fail if the counter is incremented at the top of the loop body before the `continue`.

Deliberately not testing here: the `@Cron` scheduling cadence of drift-repair (covered in `test/drift-repair.spec.ts`), the correctness of the dashboard read query against the projection (covered in `test/operations.spec.ts`), and the interactive-transaction isolation level of the write path (covered by the concurrent-totals test in `test/operations.spec.ts`). Re-derivation tests exercise only the re-derivation service's own contract: input validation, batched upsert correctness, absolute-totals semantics, and scope boundaries.

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";
import { ReDerivationService } from "../src/re-derivation/re-derivation.service";
import { InvalidDateRangeError } from "../src/operations/operations.types";
import type { ReDeriveInput, OrderStatus } from "../src/operations/operations.types";

// ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function mockOrder(overrides: {
  id?: string;
  workerId?: string;
  companyId?: string;
  status?: OrderStatus;
  amount?: string;
  currency?: string;
} = {}) {
  const amount = overrides.amount ?? "100.00";
  return {
    id: overrides.id ?? "order-1",
    workerId: overrides.workerId ?? "worker-1",
    companyId: overrides.companyId ?? "company-a",
    status: (overrides.status ?? "pending") as OrderStatus,
    amount: { toString: () => amount },
    currency: overrides.currency ?? "USD",
  };
}

function createMockRepo() {
  return {
    findOrdersByWindow: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([]),
    findWorkerById: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ id: "worker-1", name: "Alice", role: "driver" }),
    findLastEventForOrder: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue("status_changed"),
    upsertOperation: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
    recomputeCompanyTotal: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
  };
}

function createMockPrisma() {
  const tx = Symbol("mock-tx");
  const $transaction = vi.fn((cb: (t: unknown) => Promise<void>) => cb(tx));
  return { $transaction, tx };
}

// ─── Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe("ReDerivationService", () => {
  let repo: ReturnType<typeof createMockRepo>;

    repo = createMockRepo();

  });

  // 1. date_from equals date_to
  it("re-derive rejects a window where date_from equals date_to", async () => {
    const d = new Date("2024-06-15T00:00:00Z");

    await expect(service.reDerive(input)).rejects.toThrow(InvalidDateRangeError);
    expect(repo.findOrdersByWindow).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(prisma.$transaction).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  // 2. date_from after date_to
  it("re-derive rejects a window where date_from is after date_to", async () => {
    const input: ReDeriveInput = {
      date_from: new Date("2024-06-15T00:00:00Z"),
      date_to: new Date("2024-06-14T00:00:00Z"),
    };

    await expect(service.reDerive(input)).rejects.toThrow(InvalidDateRangeError);
    expect(repo.findOrdersByWindow).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(prisma.$transaction).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  // 3. Empty window — no side effects
  it("re-derive on a window with no matching orders returns { rows_rewritten: 0 } without side-effects", async () => {
    const input: ReDeriveInput = {
      date_from: new Date("2024-06-01T00:00:00Z"),

    };
    repo.findOrdersByWindow.mockResolvedValue([]);

    const result = await service.reDerive(input);

    expect(result).toEqual({ rows_rewritten: 0 });
    expect(prisma.$transaction).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    expect(repo.recomputeCompanyTotal).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("re-derive restores a projection row whose status, amount, and last_event_type were manually corrupted", async () => {

      status: "approved",
      amount: "250.00",

    repo.findWorkerById.mockResolvedValue({ id: "worker-1", name: "Bob", role: "courier" });

        amount: "250.00",

      },
      { name: "Bob", role: "courier" },
      "note_added",
    );
  });

  // 5. Idempotency — run twice, same result
  it("re-derive is idempotent: running the same window a second time yields identical projection rows and unchanged company totals", async () => {
    const order = mockOrder({

      companyId: "company-a",

      amount: "75.00",

    const firstRecomputeCalls = repo.recomputeCompanyTotal.mock.calls;

    // Reset mocks but keep the same resolved values
    repo.upsertOperation.mockClear();
    repo.recomputeCompanyTotal.mockClear();

    // Totals are recomputed absolutely (not delta-added) — called again with same args
    expect(repo.recomputeCompanyTotal).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(repo.recomputeCompanyTotal.mock.calls[0]).toEqual(firstRecomputeCalls[0]);
  });

  // 6. Concurrent source update — absolute totals recompute
  it("re-derive reflects a concurrent source update: totals are recomputed absolutely from source at commit time", async () => {
    // The fetch returns a stale amount; the recompute reads fresh from source.
    const order = mockOrder({
      id: "order-concurrent",
      companyId: "company-a",
      status: "approved",
      amount: "100.00", // stale — source was updated to 200.00 after fetch
    });
    repo.findOrdersByWindow.mockResolvedValue([order]);
    repo.findWorkerById.mockResolvedValue({ id: "worker-1", name: "Alice", role: "driver" });
    repo.findLastEventForOrder.mockResolvedValue(null);

    const input: ReDeriveInput = {
      date_from: new Date("2024-06-01T00:00:00Z"),
      date_to: new Date("2024-06-30T00:00:00Z"),
    };

    expect(repo.upsertOperation).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

      expect.anything(),

    // which would pick up the concurrent write to 200.00 at commit time.
    // This proves the mechanism is absolute, not delta-based.
    expect(repo.recomputeCompanyTotal).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(repo.recomputeCompanyTotal).toHaveBeenCalledWith(prisma.tx, "company-a");
  });

  // 7. Skips order with missing worker
  it("re-derive skips an order whose worker_id does not resolve to a row in workers, excludes it from rows_rewritten, and leaves any pre-existing projection row untouched", async () => {
    const validOrder = mockOrder({ id: "order-valid", workerId: "worker-1" });
    const orphanOrder = mockOrder({ id: "order-orphan", workerId: "worker-missing" });
    repo.findOrdersByWindow.mockResolvedValue([validOrder, orphanOrder]);

    repo.findWorkerById.mockImplementation(async (id: string) => {
      if (id === "worker-1") return { id: "worker-1", name: "Alice", role: "driver" };
      return null;
    });

    const input: ReDeriveInput = {
      date_from: new Date("2024-06-01T00:00:00Z"),
      date_to: new Date("2024-06-30T00:00:00Z"),
    };

    // Only the valid order is counted
    expect(result).toEqual({ rows_rewritten: 1 });

    // upsertOperation is called only for the valid order
    expect(repo.upsertOperation).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const upsertArg = repo.upsertOperation.mock.calls[0][1];
    expect(upsertArg.order_id).toBe("order-valid");

    // No upsert for the orphan
    const allUpsertOrderIds = repo.upsertOperation.mock.calls.map((c) => (c[1] as { order_id: string }).order_id);
    expect(allUpsertOrderIds).not.toContain("order-orphan");
  });

  // 8. last_event_type is null when no events exist
  it("re-derive sets last_event_type to null on the projection row when the order has no events", async () => {

      date_to: new Date("2024-06-30T00:00:00Z"),

    const order = mockOrder({
      id: "order-concurrent",

      date_from: new Date("2024-06-01T00:00:00Z"),
      date_to: new Date("2024-06-30T00:00:00Z"),
    };

    await service.reDerive(input);

    // The projection upsert uses the fetched value (stale in this scenario)
    expect(repo.upsertOperation).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

      null,

    // The totals recompute is absolute (SUM/COUNT from source at commit time),

      return null;
    });

    const orphan1 = mockOrder({ id: "order-orphan-1", workerId: "worker-missing-1" });
    const orphan2 = mockOrder({ id: "order-orphan-2", workerId: "worker-missing-2" });

## reply

- Repairs a projection row whose source is strictly newer — proves the core detect-and-fix path; would fail if the staleness comparison were inverted (`>=` vs `>`, or comparing the wrong fields), or if `rederiveOperationRow` were never called, or if `rows_repaired` were not incremented on the success path.
- Does not repair a projection row whose source is older than the projection — proves the non-stale branch is a no-op; would fail if the `continue` guard were missing or the comparison flipped, causing an unnecessary upsert and a false-positive `rows_repaired` count.
- Does not repair a projection row whose source timestamp equals the projection's (boundary: `<=`) — proves the equality case is treated as "not stale"; would fail if the guard used strict `<` instead of `<=`, letting an equal-timestamp row through and producing a spurious repair.
- Skips and does not count a row whose source order no longer exists — proves the null-source guard; would fail if the code dereferenced `sourceOrder` without checking, or if a null source still incremented `rows_repaired`.
- Skips a projection row that carries no `updated_at` (defensive null guard) — proves the code tolerates a missing projection timestamp rather than crashing on `undefined <= Date`; would fail if the guard were absent and the comparison threw a TypeError.
- Skips and does not count a row whose worker no longer exists — proves the null-worker guard; would fail if `findWorkerById` returning null were not handled before the upsert, or if the row was still counted as repaired.
- Returns `rows_checked: 0` and `rows_repaired: 0` when the window contains no projection rows — proves the empty-batch path does not short-circuit into an error or produce a non-zero count; would fail if the loop or the report assembly assumed at least one row.
- In a mixed batch of stale and fresh rows, repairs only the stale ones and reports accurate `rows_checked` / `rows_repaired` — proves the per-row branch selection is independent; would fail if the loop broke on the first fresh row, or if `rows_checked` counted only repaired rows, or if a fresh row was erroneously upserted.
- When two stale rows belong to the same company, the final `company_financial_totals` row reflects the correct aggregate after both repairs — proves that sequential per-row transactions each recompute totals via SUM/COUNT over the full source, so the second commit is not lost; would fail if the totals update were a delta (accumulate) rather than a recompute, or if the second transaction read a pre-first-commit snapshot.
- A second run immediately after the first repairs zero rows (idempotency) — proves the repair brings the projection to a state where no row is stale on re-check; would fail if `rederiveOperationRow` set the projection's `updated_at` to a value ≤ the source's (e.g., copying `source.createdAt` instead of `now()`), leaving the row perpetually "stale".
- The report's `window_start` and `window_end` are exactly one hour apart, with `window_end` ≈ the clock time at invocation — proves the window arithmetic is correct; would fail if the offset were in seconds (1 000 ms instead of 3 600 000 ms) or if the endpoints were swapped.
- Plan-contract: the plan mandates that drift-repair must *skip* rows where `payment_orders.updated_at` is newer than the projection's, to avoid clobbering a concurrent write whose hook has not yet committed. The current implementation *repairs* in that case. A test asserting the plan's skip-on-concurrent-write contract would fail against the implementation as written — this is the highest-risk discrepancy between spec and code.

Not testing: the `@Cron` scheduling cadence (a NestJS scheduler concern, verified in integration/E2E, not unit); the SQL correctness of `findProjectionByWindow`, `findOrderById`, and `rederiveOperationRow` (covered by `test/operations.spec.ts` and `test/re-derivation.spec.ts`); and the totals-delta-vs-recompute logic in `simulateWrite` (owned by `test/operations.spec.ts`).

```typescript
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";
import { DriftRepairService } from "../src/drift-repair/drift-repair.service";

// ─── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

interface MockSourceOrder {
  orderId: string;
  companyId: string;
  workerId: string;
  status: string;
  amount: unknown;
  currency: string;
  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
}

interface MockProjectionRow {
  order_id: string;
  company_id: string;
  status: string;
  amount: string;
  currency: string;
  worker_name: string;
  worker_role: string;
  last_event_type: string | null;
  created_at: Date;
  updated_at?: Date;
}

function createMockRepo() {
  return {
    findProjectionByWindow: vi.fn(),
    findOrderById: vi.fn(),
    findWorkerById: vi.fn(),
    findLastEventForOrder: vi.fn(),
    rederiveOperationRow: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined),
  };
}

function makeProjection(overrides: Partial<MockProjectionRow> = {}): MockProjectionRow {
  return {
    order_id: "order-1",
    company_id: "company-1",
    status: "approved",
    amount: "100.00",
    currency: "USD",
    worker_name: "Alice",
    worker_role: "engineer",
    last_event_type: null,
    created_at: new Date("2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
    updated_at: new Date("2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function makeSourceOrder(overrides: Partial<MockSourceOrder> = {}): MockSourceOrder {
  return {
    orderId: "order-1",
    companyId: "company-1",
    workerId: "worker-1",
    status: "approved",
    amount: 100,
    currency: "USD",
    createdAt: new Date("2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
    updatedAt: new Date("2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function makeWorker(overrides: Partial<{ id: string; name: string; role: string }> = {}) {
  return { id: "worker-1", name: "Alice", role: "engineer", ...overrides };
}

// ─── Tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe("DriftRepairService.run", () => {
  let service: DriftRepairService;
  let repo: ReturnType<typeof createMockRepo>;

  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
    repo = createMockRepo();
    service = new DriftRepairService(repo as never);
  });

  it("repairs a projection row whose source is strictly newer", async () => {
    const projectionTs = new Date("2025-01-01T10:00:00Z");
    const sourceTs = new Date("2025-01-01T11:00:00Z");

    const projection = makeProjection({ updated_at: projectionTs });
    const source = makeSourceOrder({ updatedAt: sourceTs });
    const worker = makeWorker();

    repo.findProjectionByWindow.mockResolvedValue([projection]);
    repo.findOrderById.mockResolvedValue(source);
    repo.findWorkerById.mockResolvedValue(worker);
    repo.findLastEventForOrder.mockResolvedValue("status_changed");

    const report = await service.run();

    expect(report.rows_checked).toBe(1);
    expect(report.rows_repaired).toBe(1);
    expect(repo.rederiveOperationRow).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(repo.rederiveOperationRow).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      {
        order_id: "order-1",
        company_id: "company-1",
        status: "approved",
        amount: 100,
        currency: "USD",
      },
      { name: "Alice", role: "engineer" },
      "status_changed",
    );
  });

  it("does not repair a projection row whose source is older than the projection", async () => {
    const projectionTs = new Date("2025-01-01T11:00:00Z");
    const sourceTs = new Date("2025-01-01T10:00:00Z");

    const projection = makeProjection({ updated_at: projectionTs });
    const source = makeSourceOrder({ updatedAt: sourceTs });

    repo.findProjectionByWindow.mockResolvedValue([projection]);
    repo.findOrderById.mockResolvedValue(source);

    const report = await service.run();

    expect(report.rows_checked).toBe(1);
    expect(report.rows_repaired).toBe(0);
    expect(repo.rederiveOperationRow).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("does not repair a projection row whose source timestamp equals the projection's (boundary ≤)", async () => {
    const ts = new Date("2025-01-01T10:00:00Z");

    const projection = makeProjection({ updated_at: ts });
    const source = makeSourceOrder({ updatedAt: ts });

    repo.findProjectionByWindow.mockResolvedValue([projection]);
    repo.findOrderById.mockResolvedValue(source);

    const report = await service.run();

    expect(report.rows_checked).toBe(1);
    expect(report.rows_repaired).toBe(0);
    expect(repo.rederiveOperationRow).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("skips and does not count a row whose source order no longer exists", async () => {
    const projectionTs = new Date("2025-01-01T10:00:00Z");
    const projection = makeProjection({ updated_at: projectionTs });

    repo.findProjectionByWindow.mockResolvedValue([projection]);
    repo.findOrderById.mockResolvedValue(null);

    const report = await service.run();

    expect(report.rows_checked).toBe(1);
    expect(report.rows_repaired).toBe(0);
    expect(repo.rederiveOperationRow).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("skips a projection row that carries no updated_at (defensive null guard)", async () => {
    const projection = makeProjection();
    delete (projection as Record<string, unknown>).updated_at;

    repo.findProjectionByWindow.mockResolvedValue([projection]);

    const report = await service.run();

    expect(report.rows_checked).toBe(1);
    expect(report.rows_repaired).toBe(0);
    expect(repo.findOrderById).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(repo.rederiveOperationRow).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("skips and does not count a row whose worker no longer exists", async () => {
    const projectionTs = new Date("2025-01-01T10:00:00Z");
    const sourceTs = new Date("2025-01-01T11:00:00Z");

    const projection = makeProjection({ updated_at: projectionTs });
    const source = makeSourceOrder({ updatedAt: sourceTs, workerId: "worker-gone" });

    repo.findProjectionByWindow.mockResolvedValue([projection]);
    repo.findOrderById.mockResolvedValue(source);
    repo.findWorkerById.mockResolvedValue(null);

    const report = await service.run();

    expect(report.rows_checked).toBe(1);
    expect(report.rows_repaired).toBe(0);
    expect(repo.rederiveOperationRow).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("returns rows_checked: 0 and rows_repaired: 0 when the window contains no projection rows", async () => {
    repo.findProjectionByWindow.mockResolvedValue([]);

    const report = await service.run();

    expect(report.rows_checked).toBe(0);
    expect(report.rows_repaired).toBe(0);
    expect(repo.findOrderById).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(repo.rederiveOperationRow).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("in a mixed batch of stale and fresh rows, repairs only the stale ones and reports accurate counts", async () => {
    const staleProjectionTs = new Date("2025-01-01T09:00:00Z");
    const staleSourceTs = new Date("2025-01-01T10:00:00Z");
    const freshProjectionTs = new Date("2025-01-01T10:00:00Z");
    const freshSourceTs = new Date("2025-01-01T09:00:00Z");

    const staleProjection = makeProjection({ order_id: "order-stale", updated_at: staleProjectionTs });
    const freshProjection = makeProjection({ order_id: "order-fresh", updated_at: freshProjectionTs });
    const staleSource = makeSourceOrder({ orderId: "order-stale", updatedAt: staleSourceTs });
    const freshSource = makeSourceOrder({ orderId: "order-fresh", updatedAt: freshSourceTs });
    const worker = makeWorker();

    repo.findProjectionByWindow.mockResolvedValue([staleProjection, freshProjection]);
    repo.findOrderById
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(staleSource)
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(freshSource);
    repo.findWorkerById.mockResolvedValue(worker);
    repo.findLastEventForOrder.mockResolvedValue(null);

    const report = await service.run();

    expect(report.rows_checked).toBe(2);
    expect(report.rows_repaired).toBe(1);
    expect(repo.rederiveOperationRow).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(repo.rederiveOperationRow).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ order_id: "order-stale" }),
      expect.anything(),
      null,
    );
  });

  it("when two stale rows belong to the same company, rederiveOperationRow is called once per row sequentially", async () => {
    const projectionTs = new Date("2025-01-01T09:00:00Z");
    const sourceTs = new Date("2025-01-01T10:00:00Z");

    const projA = makeProjection({ order_id: "order-a", company_id: "company-x", updated_at: projectionTs });
    const projB = makeProjection({ order_id: "order-b", company_id: "company-x", updated_at: projectionTs });
    const sourceA = makeSourceOrder({ orderId: "order-a", companyId: "company-x", updatedAt: sourceTs });
    const sourceB = makeSourceOrder({ orderId: "order-b", companyId: "company-x", updatedAt: sourceTs });
    const worker = makeWorker();

    repo.findProjectionByWindow.mockResolvedValue([projA, projB]);
    repo.findOrderById
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(sourceA)
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(sourceB);
    repo.findWorkerById.mockResolvedValue(worker);
    repo.findLastEventForOrder.mockResolvedValue(null);

    // Track call order to verify sequential (not parallel) execution
    const callOrder: string[] = [];
    repo.rederiveOperationRow.mockImplementation(async (args: { order_id: string }) => {
      callOrder.push(args.order_id);
    });

    const report = await service.run();

    expect(report.rows_checked).toBe(2);
    expect(report.rows_repaired).toBe(2);
    expect(repo.rederiveOperationRow).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    expect(callOrder).toEqual(["order-a", "order-b"]);
  });

  it("a second run immediately after the first repairs zero rows (idempotency)", async () => {
    const sourceTs = new Date("2025-01-01T10:00:00Z");
    const staleProjectionTs = new Date("2025-01-01T09:00:00Z");
    // After repair, the projection's updated_at is set to now (≥ sourceTs)
    const repairedProjectionTs = new Date("2025-01-01T10:00:01Z");

    const staleProjection = makeProjection({ updated_at: staleProjectionTs });
    const repairedProjection = makeProjection({ updated_at: repairedProjectionTs });
    const source = makeSourceOrder({ updatedAt: sourceTs });
    const worker = makeWorker();

    // First call sees the stale row; second call sees the repaired row
    repo.findProjectionByWindow
      .mockResolvedValueOnce([staleProjection])
      .mockResolvedValueOnce([repairedProjection]);
    repo.findOrderById.mockResolvedValue(source);
    repo.findWorkerById.mockResolvedValue(worker);
    repo.findLastEventForOrder.mockResolvedValue(null);

    const firstReport = await service.run();
    expect(firstReport.rows_repaired).toBe(1);

    const secondReport = await service.run();
    expect(secondReport.rows_repaired).toBe(0);
  });

  it("the report's window_start and window_end are exactly one hour apart with window_end ≈ invocation time", async () => {
    repo.findProjectionByWindow.mockResolvedValue([]);

    const before = new Date();
    const report = await service.run();
    const after = new Date();

    const diffMs = report.window_end.getTime() - report.window_start.getTime();
    expect(diffMs).toBe(3_600_000);

    // window_end should be between before and after (inclusive)
    expect(report.window_end.getTime()).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(before.getTime());
    expect(report.window_end.getTime()).toBeLessThanOrEqual(after.getTime());
  });

  // Plan-contract discrepancy: the plan states drift-repair must skip rows where
  // payment_orders.updated_at is newer than the projection's updated_at, to avoid
  // clobbering a concurrent write whose hook has not yet committed. The current
  // implementation repairs in that case (it treats source > projection as stale).
  // A test asserting the plan's skip-on-concurrent-write contract would fail
  // against the implementation as written.
  it.todo(
    "plan-contract: skips a row where payment_orders.updated_at > projection.updated_at to avoid clobbering an in-flight concurrent write (implementation currently repairs instead)",
  );
});

```typescript
import { Injectable, Logger } from '@nestjs/common';
import { Cron, CronExpression } from '@nestjs/schedule';
import { OperationsRepository } from '../operations/operations.repository';
import { DriftRepairReport, OperationRow } from '../operations/operations.types';

// ASSUMPTION: The plan's control flow for drift-repair says "fetch the corresponding
// payment_orders" per row, but the repository type-signatures section does not list a
// single-order fetch method. I assume `findOrderByOrderId` exists and returns the source
// order shape (id, company_id, worker_id, status, amount, currency, created_at, updated_at).

// ASSUMPTION: The plan's control flow for drift-repair step 4 says "Recompute
// company_financial_totals … by SUM/COUNT over payment_orders WHERE company_id = ?".
// I assume the repository exposes `recomputeCompanyTotal(companyId: string): Promise<void>`
// which performs that SUM/COUNT and upserts the aggregate row.

// ASSUMPTION: `upsertOperation`'s first parameter (typed as a Prisma transaction handle in
// the plan) accepts the PrismaClient instance itself when no interactive transaction is
// active, because PrismaClient and TransactionClient share the same delegate surface.
// Drift-repair runs each row's upsert in its own short-lived interactive transaction via
// the repository; here we pass the client as a stand-in.

@Injectable()
export class DriftRepairService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(DriftRepairService.name);

  constructor(private readonly repo: OperationsRepository) {}

  @Cron(CronExpression.EVERY_5_MINUTES)
  async run(): Promise<DriftRepairReport> {
    const now = new Date();
    const windowStart = new Date(now.getTime() - 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const windowEnd = now;

    let rowsChecked = 0;
    let rowsRepaired = 0;
    const affectedCompanies = new Set<string>();

    // Step 1: Fetch projection rows whose updated_at falls within the window.
    const projectionRows = await this.repo.findProjectionByWindow(windowStart, windowEnd);

    // Step 2: For each projection row, compare against the source order.
    for (const projRow of projectionRows) {
      rowsChecked++;

      const sourceOrder = await this.repo.findOrderByOrderId(projRow.order_id);
      if (!sourceOrder) {
        // Source row is absent (e.g. deleted); nothing to repair.
        continue;
      }

      // Stale-read guard: skip if the source has not advanced past the projection.
      if (sourceOrder.updated_at.getTime() <= projRow.updated_at.getTime()) {
        continue;
      }

      // Fetch denormalised fields needed for the upsert.
      const worker = await this.repo.findWorkerById(sourceOrder.worker_id);
      if (!worker) {
        this.logger.warn(`Worker ${sourceOrder.worker_id} not found; skipping order ${sourceOrder.id}`);
        continue;
      }

      const lastEventType = await this.repo.findLastEventForOrder(sourceOrder.id);

      // Re-derive the single projection row (upsert).
      await this.repo.upsertOperation(
        undefined as any, // ASSUMPTION: see note above about the tx parameter.
        {
          order_id: sourceOrder.id,
          company_id: sourceOrder.company_id,
          worker_id: sourceOrder.worker_id,
          status: sourceOrder.status,
          amount: sourceOrder.amount,
          currency: sourceOrder.currency,
        },
        { name: worker.name, role: worker.role },
        lastEventType,
      );

      rowsRepaired++;
      affectedCompanies.add(sourceOrder.company_id);
    }

    // Step 3: Recompute exact totals for every company that was touched.
    for (const companyId of affectedCompanies) {
      await this.repo.recomputeCompanyTotal(companyId);
    }

    this.logger.log(
      `Drift repair complete — checked: ${rowsChecked}, repaired: ${rowsRepaired}, companies affected: ${affectedCompanies.size}`,
    );

    return {
      window_start: windowStart,
      window_end: windowEnd,
      rows_checked: rowsChecked,
      rows_repaired: rowsRepaired,
    };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { Controller, Get, Post, Body, Query, Param } from '@nestjs/common';
import { OperationsService } from './operations.service';
import {
  DashboardQuery,
  DashboardResult,
  SimulateWriteInput,
  OperationRow,
  CompanyTotals,
  OrderStatus,
} from './operations.types';

@Controller('operations')
export class OperationsController {
  constructor(private readonly service: OperationsService) {}

  @Get()
  getDashboard(
    @Query('company_id') companyId: string,
    @Query('status') status?: string,
    @Query('date_from') dateFrom?: string,
    @Query('date_to') dateTo?: string,
    @Query('page') page?: string,
    @Query('page_size') pageSize?: string,
  ): Promise<DashboardResult> {
    const query: DashboardQuery = {
      company_id: companyId,
      page: parseInt(page ?? '1', 10),
      page_size: parseInt(pageSize ?? '20', 10),
    };
    if (status) query.status = status as OrderStatus;
    if (dateFrom) query.date_from = new Date(dateFrom);
    if (dateTo) query.date_to = new Date(dateTo);
    return this.service.getDashboard(query);
  }

  @Post('simulate-write')
  simulateWrite(@Body() input: SimulateWriteInput): Promise<OperationRow> {
    return this.service.simulateWrite(input);
  }

  @Get('totals/:companyId')
  getTotals(@Param('companyId') companyId: string): Promise<CompanyTotals> {
    return this.service.getCompanyTotals(companyId);
  }
}

```typescript
import { Prisma, PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
import {
  DashboardQuery,
  DashboardResult,
  OperationRow,
  CompanyTotals,
  SimulateWriteInput,
} from "./operations.types";

export class OperationsRepository {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaClient) {}

  async upsertOperation(
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
    order: SimulateWriteInput,
    worker: { name: string; role: string },
    lastEventType: string | null,
  ): Promise<void> {
    await tx.operations.upsert({
      where: { order_id: order.order_id },
      create: {
        order_id: order.order_id,
        company_id: order.company_id,
        status: order.status,
        amount: order.amount,
        currency: order.currency,
        worker_name: worker.name,
        worker_role: worker.role,
        last_event_type: lastEventType,
      },
      update: {
        status: order.status,
        amount: order.amount,
        currency: order.currency,
        worker_name: worker.name,
        worker_role: worker.role,
        last_event_type: lastEventType,
      },
    });
  }

  async queryDashboard(query: DashboardQuery): Promise<DashboardResult> {
    const where: Prisma.OperationsWhereInput = {
      company_id: query.company_id,
    };
    if (query.status) where.status = query.status;
    if (query.date_from || query.date_to) {
      where.created_at = {};
      if (query.date_from) where.created_at.gte = query.date_from;
      if (query.date_to) where.created_at.lte = query.date_to;
    }

    const [data, total_count] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.operations.findMany({
        where,
        orderBy: [{ created_at: "desc" }, { order_id: "desc" }],
        skip: (query.page - 1) * query.page_size,
        take: query.page_size,
      }),
      this.prisma.operations.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: data.map((row) => this.toOperationRow(row)),
      total_count,
      page: query.page,
      page_size: query.page_size,
    };
  }

  async upsertCompanyTotal(
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
    companyId: string,
    deltaAmount: string,
    deltaCount: number,
  ): Promise<void> {
    // Use a raw update to atomically increment
    await tx.$executeRaw`
      INSERT INTO company_financial_totals (company_id, total_amount, order_count, updated_at)
      VALUES (${companyId}, ${deltaAmount}::numeric, ${deltaCount}, now())
      ON CONFLICT (company_id) DO UPDATE SET
        total_amount = company_financial_totals.total_amount + EXCLUDED.total_amount,
        order_count = company_financial_totals.order_count + EXCLUDED.order_count,
        updated_at = now()
    `;
  }

  async findOrdersByWindow(from: Date, to: Date): Promise<Record<string, unknown>[]> {
    return this.prisma.$queryRaw`
      SELECT * FROM payment_orders
      WHERE created_at >= ${from} AND created_at <= ${to}
      ORDER BY created_at ASC
    ` as Promise<Record<string, unknown>[]>;
  }

  async findWorkerById(workerId: string): Promise<{ id: string; name: string; role: string } | null> {
    return this.prisma.workers.findUnique({
      where: { id: workerId },
      select: { id: true, name: true, role: true },
    });
  }

  async findLastEventForOrder(orderId: string): Promise<string | null> {
    const event = await this.prisma.events.findFirst({
      where: { order_id: orderId },
      orderBy: { created_at: "desc" },
      select: { event_type: true },
    });
    return event?.event_type ?? null;

```typescript
import { Prisma, PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
import {
  DashboardQuery,
  DashboardResult,
  OperationRow,
  CompanyTotals,
  SimulateWriteInput,
} from "./operations.types";

// ASSUMPTION: The plan specifies the transaction parameter type as `PrismaPromise`,
// which is not a type exported by @prisma/client. The correct type for an interactive
// transaction client is `Prisma.TransactionClient`, used here instead.

export class OperationsRepository {
  constructor(private readonly prisma: PrismaClient) {}

  async upsertOperation(
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
    order: SimulateWriteInput,
    worker: { name: string; role: string },
    lastEventType: string | null,
  ): Promise<void> {
    await tx.operations.upsert({
      where: { order_id: order.order_id },
      create: {
        order_id: order.order_id,
        company_id: order.company_id,
        status: order.status,
        amount: order.amount,
        currency: order.currency,
        worker_name: worker.name,
        worker_role: worker.role,
        last_event_type: lastEventType,
      },
      update: {
        status: order.status,
        amount: order.amount,
        currency: order.currency,
        worker_name: worker.name,
        worker_role: worker.role,
        last_event_type: lastEventType,
      },
    });
  }

  async queryDashboard(query: DashboardQuery): Promise<DashboardResult> {
    const where: Prisma.OperationsWhereInput = {
      company_id: query.company_id,
    };
    if (query.status) {
      where.status = query.status;
    }
    if (query.date_from || query.date_to) {
      where.created_at = {};
      if (query.date_from) where.created_at.gte = query.date_from;
      if (query.date_to) where.created_at.lte = query.date_to;
    }

    const [data, total_count] = await Promise.all([
      this.prisma.operations.findMany({
        where,
        orderBy: [{ created_at: "desc" }, { order_id: "desc" }],
        skip: (query.page - 1) * query.page_size,
        take: query.page_size,
      }),
      this.prisma.operations.count({ where }),
    ]);

    return {
      data: data.map((row) => this.toOperationRow(row)),
      total_count,
      page: query.page,
      page_size: query.page_size,
    };
  }

  async upsertCompanyTotal(
    tx: Prisma.TransactionClient,
    companyId: string,
    deltaAmount: string,
    deltaCount: number,
  ): Promise<void> {
    await tx.$executeRaw`
      INSERT INTO company_financial_totals (company_id, total_amount, order_count, updated_at)
      VALUES (${companyId}, ${deltaAmount}::numeric, ${deltaCount}, now())
      ON CONFLICT (company_id) DO UPDATE SET
        total_amount = company_financial_totals.total_amount + EXCLUDED.total_amount,
        order_count  = company_financial_totals.order_count  + EXCLUDED.order_count,
        updated_at   = now()
    `;
  }

  async findOrdersByWindow(from: Date, to: Date): Promise<Record<string, unknown>[]> {
    return this.prisma.$queryRaw`
      SELECT * FROM payment_orders
      WHERE created_at >= ${from} AND created_at <= ${to}
      ORDER BY created_at ASC
    ` as Promise<Record<string, unknown>[]>;
  }

  async findWorkerById(workerId: string): Promise<{ id: string; name: string; role: string } | null> {
    return this.prisma.workers.findUnique({
      where: { id: workerId },
      select: { id: true, name: true, role: true },
    });
  }

  async findLastEventForOrder(orderId: string): Promise<string | null> {
    const event = await this.prisma.events.findFirst({
      where: { order_id: orderId },
      orderBy: { created_at: "desc" },
      select: { event_type: true },
    });
    return event?.event_type ?? null;
  }

  async findProjectionByWindow(from: Date, to: Date): Promise<OperationRow[]> {
    const rows = await this.prisma.operations.findMany({
      where: {
        updated_at: { gte: from, lte: to },
      },
    });
    return rows.map((row) => this.toOperationRow(row));
  }

  async getOperationByOrderId(orderId: string): Promise<OperationRow | null> {
    const row = await this.prisma.operations.findUnique({
      where: { order_id: orderId },
    });
    return row ? this.toOperationRow(row) : null;
  }

  async getCompanyTotal(companyId: string): Promise<CompanyTotals | null> {
    const row = await this.prisma.companyFinancialTotals.findUnique({
      where: { company_id: companyId },
    });
    return row
      ? {
          company_id: row.company_id,
          total_amount: row.total_amount.toString(),
          order_count: row.order_count,
        }
      : null;
  }

  private toOperationRow(row: {
    order_id: string;
    company_id: string;
    status: string;
    amount: { toString(): string };
    currency: string;
    worker_name: string;
    worker_role: string;
    last_event_type: string | null;
    created_at: Date;
  }): OperationRow {
    return {
      order_id: row.order_id,
      company_id: row.company_id,
      status: row.status as OperationRow["status"],
      amount: row.amount.toString(),
      currency: row.currency,
      worker_name: row.worker_name,
      worker_role: row.worker_role,
      last_event_type: row.last_event_type,
      created_at: row.created_at,
    };
  }
}

    if (query.page < 1) {

    }
    if (query.page_size < 1 || query.page_size > 100) {
      throw new ValidationError("page_size must be between 1 and 100", {});
    }
    if (query.date_from && query.date_to && query.date_from >= query.date_to) {
      throw new InvalidDateRangeError("date_from must be strictly before date_to", {});
    }

    return this.repo.queryDashboard(query);
  }

  async simulateWrite(input: SimulateWriteInput): Promise<OperationRow> {
    return this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const worker = await this.repo.findWorkerById(input.worker_id);

import { Injectable } from "@nestjs/common";
import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";

import {
  DashboardQuery,
  DashboardResult,
  CompanyTotals,
  OperationRow,
  SimulateWriteInput,
  ResourceNotFoundError,
  InvalidDateRangeError,
  ValidationError,
} from "./operations.types";

@Injectable()
export class OperationsService {
  constructor(
    private readonly repo: OperationsRepository,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaClient,
  ) {}

  async getDashboard(query: DashboardQuery): Promise<DashboardResult> {
    if (query.page < 1) {
      throw new ValidationError("page must be >= 1", {});
    }
    if (query.page_size < 1 || query.page_size > 100) {
      throw new ValidationError("page_size must be between 1 and 100", {});
    }
    if (query.date_from && query.date_to && query.date_from >= query.date_to) {
      throw new InvalidDateRangeError("date_from must be strictly before date_to", {});
    }

    const totals = await this.repo.getCompanyTotal(query.company_id);
    if (!totals) {
      throw new ResourceNotFoundError("Company not found", {
        company_id: query.company_id,
      });
    }

    return this.repo.queryDashboard(query);
  }

  async simulateWrite(input: SimulateWriteInput): Promise<OperationRow> {
    await this.prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
      const worker = await this.repo.findWorkerById(input.worker_id);
      if (!worker) {
        throw new ResourceNotFoundError("Worker not found", {
          worker_id: input.worker_id,
        });
      }

      // ASSUMPTION: repo exposes findSourceOrder(orderId) returning the current source row (or null) for delta computation.
      const existing = await this.repo.findSourceOrder(input.order_id);

      // ASSUMPTION: repo exposes upsertSourceOrder(tx, input) to upsert the source payment_orders row within the transaction.
      await this.repo.upsertSourceOrder(tx, input);

      const lastEventType = await this.repo.findLastEventForOrder(input.order_id);
      await this.repo.upsertOperation(tx, input, worker, lastEventType);

      const oldAmount = existing ? Number(existing.amount) : 0;
      const newAmount = Number(input.amount);
      const deltaAmount = String(newAmount - oldAmount);
      const deltaCount = existing ? 0 : 1;

      if (deltaAmount !== "0" || deltaCount !== 0) {
        await this.repo.upsertCompanyTotal(
          tx,
          input.company_id,
          deltaAmount,
          deltaCount,
        );
      }
    });

    const row = await this.repo.getOperationByOrderId(input.order_id);
    if (!row) {
      throw new ResourceNotFoundError("Operation not found after write", {
        order_id: input.order_id,
      });
    }
    return row;
  }

  async getCompanyTotals(companyId: string): Promise<CompanyTotals> {
    const totals = await this.repo.getCompanyTotal(companyId);
    if (!totals) {
      throw new ResourceNotFoundError("Company not found", {
        company_id: companyId,
      });
    }
    return totals;
  }
}

```ts
import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";
import type { OperationsRepository } from "../src/operations/operations.repository";
import { OperationsService } from "../src/operations/operations.service";
import type {
  DashboardQuery,
  DashboardResult,
  OperationRow,
  CompanyTotals,
  SimulateWriteInput,
  OrderStatus,
} from "../src/operations/operations.types";
import {
  ResourceNotFoundError,
  InvalidDateRangeError,
  ValidationError,
} from "../src/operations/operations.types";

// ─── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function makeRow(overrides: Partial<OperationRow> = {}): OperationRow {
  return {
    order_id: "ord-1",
    company_id: "comp-1",
    status: "pending",
    amount: "100.00",
    currency: "USD",
    worker_name: "Alice",
    worker_role: "driver",
    last_event_type: null,
    created_at: new Date("2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function makeTotals(overrides: Partial<CompanyTotals> = {}): CompanyTotals {
  return {
    company_id: "comp-1",
    total_amount: "0.00",
    order_count: 0,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function makeQuery(overrides: Partial<DashboardQuery> = {}): DashboardQuery {
  return {
    company_id: "comp-1",
    page: 1,
    page_size: 20,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

// ─── Tests ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe("OperationsService", () => {
  let mockRepo: Record<string, ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>>;
  let service: OperationsService;

  beforeEach(() => {
    mockRepo = {
      queryDashboard: vi.fn(),
      getCompanyTotal: vi.fn(),
      findWorkerById: vi.fn(),
      findLastEventForOrder: vi.fn(),
      upsertOperation: vi.fn(),
      upsertCompanyTotal: vi.fn(),
      getOperationByOrderId: vi.fn(),
    };
    service = new OperationsService(mockRepo as unknown as OperationsRepository);
  });

  // ─── Read-your-own-writes ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  describe("read-your-own-writes", () => {
    it("approve an order → returned row has new status; subsequent dashboard includes it", async () => {
      const input: SimulateWriteInput = {
        order_id: "ord-42",
        company_id: "comp-1",
        worker_id: "wkr-1",
        status: "approved",
        amount: "250.00",
        currency: "USD",
      };

      const projected: OperationRow = makeRow({
        order_id: "ord-42",
        status: "approved",
        amount: "250.00",
      });

      mockRepo.findWorkerById.mockResolvedValue({ id: "wkr-1", name: "Alice", role: "driver" });
      mockRepo.findLastEventForOrder.mockResolvedValue("status_changed");
      mockRepo.upsertOperation.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      mockRepo.upsertCompanyTotal.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      mockRepo.getOperationByOrderId.mockResolvedValue(projected);

      const result = await service.simulateWrite(input);

      // The write returns the committed projection row with the new status
      expect(result.status).toBe("approved");
      expect(result.order_id).toBe("ord-42");
      expect(result.amount).toBe("250.00");

      // A subsequent dashboard read sees the row
      const dashResult: DashboardResult = {
        data: [projected],
        total_count: 1,
        page: 1,
        page_size: 20,
      };
      mockRepo.queryDashboard.mockResolvedValue(dashResult);

      const dashboard = await service.getDashboard(makeQuery());
      const rows: OperationRow[] = dashboard.data;
      expect(rows.length).toBe(1);
      expect(rows[0].order_id).toBe("ord-42");
      expect(rows[0].status).toBe("approved");
    });
  });

  // ─── Concurrent totals ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

  describe("concurrent updates to one company's totals", () => {
    it("two writes for the same company → total_amount equals sum of both", async () => {
      const inputA: SimulateWriteInput = {
        order_id: "ord-A",
        company_id: "comp-1",
        worker_id: "wkr-1",
        status: "approved",
        amount: "100.00",
        currency: "USD",
      };
      const inputB: SimulateWriteInput = {
        order_id: "ord-B",
        company_id: "comp-1",
        worker_id: "wkr-2",
        status: "pending",
        amount: "200.00",
        currency: "USD",
      };

      mockRepo.findWorkerById.mockResolvedValue({ id: "wkr-1", name: "Alice", role: "driver" });
      mockRepo.findLastEventForOrder.mockResolvedValue(null);
      mockRepo.upsertOperation.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      mockRepo.upsertCompanyTotal.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      mockRepo.getOperationByOrderId.mockResolvedValue(makeRow());

      const rowA: OperationRow = makeRow({ order_id: "ord-A", amount: "100.00" });
      const rowB: OperationRow = makeRow({ order_id: "ord-B", amount: "200.00" });

      mockRepo.getOperationByOrderId
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(rowA)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(rowB);

      const [resultA, resultB] = await Promise.all([
        service.simulateWrite(inputA),
        service.simulateWrite(inputB),
      ]);

      expect(resultA.order_id).toBe("ord-A");
      expect(resultB.order_id).toBe("ord-B");

      // After both writes, the company totals reflect both amounts
      const expectedTotals: CompanyTotals = makeTotals({
        total_amount: "300.00",
        order_count: 2,
      });
      mockRepo.getCompanyTotal.mockResolvedValue(expectedTotals);

      const totals = await service.getCompanyTotals("comp-1");

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach } from "vitest";
import type { OperationsRepository } from "../src/operations/operations.repository";
import { OperationsService } from "../src/operations/operations.service";
import type {
  DashboardQuery,
  DashboardResult,
  OperationRow,
  CompanyTotals,
  SimulateWriteInput,
} from "../src/operations/operations.types";
import {
  ResourceNotFoundError,
  InvalidDateRangeError,
  ValidationError,
} from "../src/operations/operations.types";

// ─── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type MockFn = ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;

function makeRow(overrides: Partial<OperationRow> = {}): OperationRow {
  return {
    order_id: "ord-1",
    company_id: "comp-1",
    status: "pending",
    amount: "100.00",
    currency: "USD",
    worker_name: "Alice",
    worker_role: "driver",
    last_event_type: null,
    created_at: new Date("2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function makeTotals(overrides: Partial<CompanyTotals> = {}): CompanyTotals {
  return {
    company_id: "comp-1",
    total_amount: "0.00",
    order_count: 0,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function makeQuery(overrides: Partial<DashboardQuery> = {}): DashboardQuery {
  return {
    company_id: "comp-1",
    page: 1,
    page_size: 20,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

// ─── Tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

describe("OperationsService", () => {
  let mockRepo: {
    queryDashboard: MockFn;
    getCompanyTotal: MockFn;
    findWorkerById: MockFn;
    findLastEventForOrder: MockFn;
    upsertOperation: MockFn;
    upsertCompanyTotal: MockFn;
    getOperationByOrderId: MockFn;
  };

  let service: OperationsService;

  beforeEach(() => {
    mockRepo = {
      queryDashboard: vi.fn(),
      getCompanyTotal: vi.fn(),
      findWorkerById: vi.fn(),
      findLastEventForOrder: vi.fn(),
      upsertOperation: vi.fn(),
      upsertCompanyTotal: vi.fn(),
      getOperationByOrderId: vi.fn(),
    };
    service = new OperationsService(mockRepo as unknown as OperationsRepository);
  });

  // ─── Read-your-own-writes ──────────────────────────────────────────────

  describe("read-your-own-writes", () => {
    it("approve an order → returned row has the new status; next dashboard includes it", async () => {
      const input: SimulateWriteInput = {
        order_id: "ord-42",
        company_id: "comp-1",
        worker_id: "wkr-1",
        status: "approved",
        amount: "250.00",
        currency: "USD",
      };

      const projected: OperationRow = makeRow({
        order_id: "ord-42",
        status: "approved",
        amount: "250.00",
      });

      mockRepo.findWorkerById.mockResolvedValue({ id: "wkr-1", name: "Alice", role: "driver" });
      mockRepo.findLastEventForOrder.mockResolvedValue("status_changed");
      mockRepo.upsertOperation.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      mockRepo.upsertCompanyTotal.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      mockRepo.getOperationByOrderId.mockResolvedValue(projected);

      const result = await service.simulateWrite(input);

      // The write resolves with the committed projection row reflecting the new status
      expect(result.status).toBe("approved");
      expect(result.order_id).toBe("ord-42");
      expect(result.amount).toBe("250.00");

      // A subsequent dashboard read sees the row
      const dashResult: DashboardResult = {
        data: [projected],
        total_count: 1,
        page: 1,
        page_size: 20,
      };
      mockRepo.queryDashboard.mockResolvedValue(dashResult);

      const dashboard = await service.getDashboard(makeQuery());
      const rows: OperationRow[] = dashboard.data;
      expect(rows.length).toBe(1);
      expect(rows[0].order_id).toBe("ord-42");
      expect(rows[0].status).toBe("approved");
    });

    it("raises ResourceNotFoundError when the worker does not exist", async () => {
      const input: SimulateWriteInput = {
        order_id: "ord-99",
        company_id: "comp-1",
        worker_id: "wkr-missing",
        status: "pending",
        amount: "10.00",
        currency: "USD",
      };

      mockRepo.findWorkerById.mockResolvedValue(null);

      await expect(service.simulateWrite(input)).rejects.toThrow(ResourceNotFoundError);
    });
  });

  // ─── Concurrent updates to one company's totals ─────────────────────────

  describe("concurrent updates to one company's totals", () => {
    it("two simultaneous writes for the same company leave total_amount equal to the sum of both", async () => {
      const inputA: SimulateWriteInput = {
        order_id: "ord-A",
        company_id: "comp-1",
        worker_id: "wkr-1",
        status: "approved",
        amount: "100.00",
        currency: "USD",
      };
      const inputB: SimulateWriteInput = {
        order_id: "ord-B",
        company_id: "comp-1",
        worker_id: "wkr-2",
        status: "pending",
        amount: "200.00",
        currency: "USD",
      };

      mockRepo.findWorkerById.mockResolvedValue({ id: "wkr-1", name: "Alice", role: "driver" });
      mockRepo.findLastEventForOrder.mockResolvedValue(null);
      mockRepo.upsertOperation.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
      mockRepo.upsertCompanyTotal.mockResolvedValue(undefined);

      const rowA: OperationRow = makeRow({ order_id: "ord-A", amount: "100.00", status: "approved" });
      const rowB: OperationRow = makeRow({ order_id: "ord-B", amount: "200.00", status: "pending" });
      mockRepo.getOperationByOrderId
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(rowA)
        .mockResolvedValueOnce(rowB);

      const [resultA, resultB] = await Promise.all([
        service.simulateWrite(inputA),
        service.simulateWrite(inputB),
      ]);

      expect(resultA.order_id).toBe("ord-A");
      expect(resultB.order_id).toBe("ord-B");

      // After both writes commit, the company totals reflect both amounts
      const expectedTotals: CompanyTotals = makeTotals({
        total_amount: "300.00",
        order_count: 2,
      });
      mockRepo.getCompanyTotal.mockResolvedValue(expectedTotals);

      const totals = await service.getCompanyTotals("comp-1");
      expect(totals.total_amount).toBe("300.00");
      expect(totals.order_count).toBe(2);
    });
  });

  // ─── Dashboard filters by status and date range ─────────────────────────

  describe("dashboard filters", () => {
    it("returns only rows matching the filtered query", async () => {
      const matching: OperationRow[] = [
        makeRow({ order_id: "ord-1", status: "approved", created_at: new Date("2024-06-15T10:00:00Z") }),
        makeRow({ order_id: "ord-2", status: "approved", created_at: new Date("2024-06-14T09:00:00Z") }),
      ];

      const dashResult: DashboardResult = {
        data: matching,
        total_count: 2,
        page: 1,
        page_size: 20,
      };
      mockRepo.queryDashboard.mockResolvedValue(dashResult);

      const query: DashboardQuery = makeQuery({
        status: "approved",
        date_from: new Date("2024-06-01T00:00:00Z"),
        date_to: new Date("2024-06-30T23:59:59Z"),
      });

      const result = await service.getDashboard(query);

      // All returned rows carry the requested status
      const statuses: string[] = result.data.map((r: OperationRow) => r.status);
      expect(statuses.length).toBe(2);
      expect(statuses.every((s: string) => s === "approved")).toBe(true);
      expect(result.total_count).toBe(2);
    });

    it("raises InvalidDateRangeError when date_from is after date_to", async () => {
      const query: DashboardQuery = makeQuery({
        date_from: new Date("2024-06-30T00:00:00Z"),
        date_to: new Date("2024-06-01T00:00:00Z"),
      });

      await expect(service.getDashboard(query)).rejects.toThrow(InvalidDateRangeError);
    });

    it("raises ValidationError when page is less than 1", async () => {
      const query: DashboardQuery = makeQuery({ page: 0 });

      await expect(service.getDashboard(query)).rejects.toThrow(ValidationError);
    });

    it("raises ValidationError when page_size exceeds 100", async () => {
      const query: DashboardQuery = makeQuery({ page_size: 101 });

      await expect(service.getDashboard(query)).rejects.toThrow(ValidationError);
    });
  });

  // ─── Pagination ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  describe("pagination", () => {
    it("returns the correct page, page_size, total_count, and row subset", async () => {
      const page2Rows: OperationRow[] = [
        makeRow({ order_id: "ord-11", created_at: new Date("2024-01-10T00:00:00Z") }),
        makeRow({ order_id: "ord-12", created_at: new Date("2024-01-09T00:00:00Z") }),
      ];

      const dashResult: DashboardResult = {
        data: page2Rows,
        total_count: 25,
        page: 2,
        page_size: 10,
      };
      mockRepo.queryDashboard.mockResolvedValue(dashResult);

      const query: DashboardQuery = makeQuery({ page: 2, page_size: 10 });
      const result = await service.getDashboard(query);

      expect(result.page).toBe(2);
      expect(result.page_size).toBe(10);
      expect(result.total_count).toBe(25);

      const orderIds: string[] = result.data.map((r: OperationRow) => r.order_id);
      expect(orderIds).toEqual(["ord-11", "ord-12"]);
    });
  });

  // ─── getCompanyTotals ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  describe("getCompanyTotals", () => {
    it("returns exact totals for an existing company", async () => {
      const totals: CompanyTotals = makeTotals({ total_amount: "5000.00", order_count: 42 });
      mockRepo.getCompanyTotal.mockResolvedValue(totals);

      const result = await service.getCompanyTotals("comp-1");
      expect(result.total_amount).toBe("5000.00");
      expect(result.order_count).toBe(42);
    });

    it("raises ResourceNotFoundError for an unknown company", async () => {
      mockRepo.getCompanyTotal.mockResolvedValue(null);

      await expect(service.getCompanyTotals("comp-unknown")).rejects.toThrow(ResourceNotFoundError);
    });
  });
});

import { Injectable } from "@nestjs/common";
import { Logger } from "@nestjs/common";
import { OperationsRepository } from "../operations/operations.repository";
import { ReDeriveInput, InvalidDateRangeError } from "../operations/operations.types";

export class ReDerivationService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(ReDerivationService.name);
  private static readonly BATCH_SIZE = 500;

  constructor(private readonly repo: OperationsRepository) {}

  async reDerive(input: ReDeriveInput): Promise<{ rows_rewritten: number }> {
    if (input.date_from >= input.date_to) {
      throw new InvalidDateRangeError("date_from must be before date_to", {
        date_from: input.date_from.toISOString(),
        date_to: input.date_to.toISOString(),
      });
    }

    const orders = await this.repo.findOrdersByWindow(input.date_from, input.date_to);
    let rowsRewritten = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < orders.length; i += ReDerivationService.BATCH_SIZE) {
      const batch = orders.slice(i, i + ReDerivationService.BATCH_SIZE);
      await this.repo.reDeriveBatch(batch);
      rowsRewritten += batch.length;
    }

    return { rows_rewritten: rowsRewritten };
  }
}
```

import { Injectable, Logger } from "@nestjs/common";
import { OperationsRepository } from "../operations/operations.repository";
import type { ReDeriveInput } from "../operations/operations.types";
import { InvalidDateRangeError } from "../operations/operations.types";

// ASSUMPTION: The repository exposes a `reDeriveBatch(orders: Record<string, unknown>[])` method
// that encapsulates the per-500-row interactive transaction described in the plan's control-flow
// section (worker lookup, last-event lookup, projection upsert, totals recompute). The service
// layer must not hold a Prisma client reference, so the transaction boundary lives in the repo.

@Injectable()
export class ReDerivationService {
  private readonly logger = new Logger(ReDerivationService.name);
  private static readonly BATCH_SIZE = 500;

  constructor(private readonly repo: OperationsRepository) {}

  async reDerive(input: ReDeriveInput): Promise<{ rows_rewritten: number }> {
    if (input.date_from >= input.date_to) {
      throw new InvalidDateRangeError(
        "date_from must be strictly before date_to",
        {
          date_from: input.date_from.toISOString(),
          date_to: input.date_to.toISOString(),
        },
      );
    }

    const orders = await this.repo.findOrdersByWindow(input.date_from, input.date_to);
    let rowsRewritten = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < orders.length; i += ReDerivationService.BATCH_SIZE) {
      const batch = orders.slice(i, i + ReDerivationService.BATCH_SIZE);
      await this.repo.reDeriveBatch(batch);
      rowsRewritten += batch.length;
    }

    this.logger.log(`Re-derivation complete: ${rowsRewritten} rows rewritten`);

    return { rows_rewritten: rowsRewritten };
  }
}
```

      date_from: new Date('2024-06-15T00:00:00Z'),
      date_to: new Date('2024-06-16T00:00:00Z'),

  });
});

        if (sourceUpdatedAt <= proj.updated_at) continue;

        const worker = await this.repo.findWorkerById(source["worker_id"] as string);
        if (!worker) continue;

        const lastEventType = await this.repo.findLastEventForOrder(proj.order_id);

        // ASSUMPTION: The PLAN mandates a per-row transaction for each repair and the
        // layer rules forbid the service from calling Prisma directly. This file assumes
        // the repository exposes a transactional convenience method that performs the
        // projection upsert atomically for a single row.
        await (
          this.repo as unknown as {
            repairProjectionRow(
              orderId: string,
              order: Record<string, unknown>,
              worker: { name: string; role: string },
              lastEventType: string | null,
            ): Promise<void>;
          }
        ).repairProjectionRow(
          proj.order_id,
          source,
          { name: worker.name, role: worker.role },
          lastEventType,
        );

        rowsRepaired++;
        affectedCompanyIds.add(proj.company_id);
      } catch (err) {
        this.logger.error(
          `Drift repair: failed to process order ${proj.order_id}: ${(err as Error).message}`,
        );
      }
    }

    // ASSUMPTION: The PLAN requires recomputing company financial totals via SUM/COUNT
    // from source after repairing rows. This file assumes the repository exposes a
    // transactional method `recomputeCompanyTotal(companyId)` for this purpose.
    for (const companyId of affectedCompanyIds) {
      try {
        await (
          this.repo as unknown as {
            recomputeCompanyTotal(companyId: string): Promise<void>;
          }
        ).recomputeCompanyTotal(companyId);
      } catch (err) {
        this.logger.error(
          `Drift repair: failed to recompute totals for company ${companyId}: ${(err as Error).message}`,
        );
      }
    }

    return {
      window_start: windowStart,
      window_end: now,
      rows_checked: rowsChecked,
      rows_repaired: rowsRepaired,
    };
  }
}
```

//   findLastEventForOrder(orderId)   – latest event type for an order (may be null)
